imagePrompt: A teenage girl hurries towards the teeing ground where a clock shows she is a few minutes late. Another group of players waits by the tee marker, some looking at their watches.
imageAlt: Teen girl arriving late at the tee with a clock visible and other golfers waiting.

issues: The waiting group is present but not all are explicitly looking at their watches, though one has arms crossed and another golfer has a club, which could slightly reduce thematic clarity about the lateness.
imageVerification.repairPrompt: Ensure at least one person in the waiting group is clearly checking their watch, visibly reacting to the player's lateness.

questions.title: What Happens If You Are Late to Tee Off?
questions.question: You are supposed to start your game at 10:00. You arrive at the tee at 10:03. What happens?

choices.text: You can play but get two extra shots added to your score.
You are not allowed to play because you are out.
You can play and nothing happens.
You just get a warning and no penalty.

questions.explanation: If you get to the tee up to 5 minutes late, you can still play, but you must add two extra shots to your score on the first hole. If you are later than 5 minutes, you cannot play.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: The place where you start playing the hole. You hit your first shot from here.
Extra shots added to your score because you broke a rule.

questions.teachingTip: Use a clock or watch to show how much 3 minutes or 5 minutes is. Practise arriving early for your tee time.
likelyMisconceptions: Thinking you can always play with no penalty if you are late.
Thinking you are only told off and not given penalty shots.
Not knowing you cannot play if you are more than 5 minutes late.

questions.title: Penalty for Arriving Late to the Tee
questions.question: If you arrive at the tee 3 minutes after your starting time, what is the penalty?

choices.text: You may play but receive a two-stroke penalty
You can play with no penalty

questions.explanation: If you arrive within five minutes after your starting time, you may play but must add two penalty strokes. Arriving later than five minutes results in disqualification.
